Support terms

Support terms

All displayed projects are in preparation. No financial fundraising is open on this version.

Before contributing

The beneficiary, approved budget, currency, fees, allocation and shortfall or surplus rules must be communicated. No automatic refund, escrow or tax benefit is guaranteed.

Equipment, expertise and child protection

In-kind donations must be agreed with the school to useful specifications and recorded once. Activities are supervised. No contribution grants private access to children. A proposal prepared through the form is neither sent nor recorded as a financial commitment.

Version dated 21 October 2026.
